_doc: Per-ticket cost and latency limits checked by cx-gate. 'default' applies to every model; a model's own section overrides it. Latency is model time per ticket (all calls), p95. Live limits are about 1.5x what the v0.3 run measured on a MacBook (qwen2.5:7b + v4: 1,073 tokens, p95 14.8 s; llama3.2 + v4: 1,101 tokens, p95 9.0 s).
